product.name: Peter England Men's Cotton Abstract Geometric Print Polo T-Shirt – Casual Wear | Modern & Stylish
product.description: A regular-fit cotton polo T-shirt featuring an abstract geometric pattern, collared neckline and half sleeves. Designed for casual and smart-casual wear.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the product for its quality, comfort, appearance, geometric print and overall value. The main negative signal is price, with one customer specifically considering it expensive. Some reviews also indicate that the style is slightly flashy and may suit fit or slim body types better.
